mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in unemployment (UNRATE below 5.0%) signals labor market strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 5.0% in a month
failure_condition: UNRATE remains ≥5.0% throughout the period, or 20-day forward returns are negative despite the trigger occurring.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer demand (GDPC1) signals robust economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 does not increase over the 5-day horizon, or 5-day forward returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in production (INDPRO) indicates stronger supply-side conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not rise over the 20-day window, or returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals tightening monetary policy, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS never exceeds 4.0% in the period, or 20-day forward returns are positive despite the trigger occurring.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in consumer demand (GDPC1) and industrial activity (HOUST) signal a robust economic upturn, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases by >5% and HOUST increases by >10%
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 or HOUST does not meet their respective increase thresholds, or 20-day returns are negative despite both rising.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle periods, FEDFUNDS does not decline sufficiently, or 20-day forward returns are negative despite the decline.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in production (INDPRO) and demand (RSAFS) exceeding 5% over 60 days signal a robust supply-demand balance, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: Both INDPRO and RSAFS increase by >5% over the 60-day horizon
failure_condition: Either INDPRO or RSAFS does not increase by >5% over the 60-day horizon, or 60-day returns are negative despite both rising.
